description: Format 1's refusal of format 2 (D-EVS-39, D-PHASE-9, FI-17, FS-72's and FS-95's format-1 cases): each signed, well-formed format-2 construct, the reserved numbers it uses, the side that meets it and what format-1 code answers, with a malformed or unsigned twin that must not answer as needing format 2. sidecartest/evs_format2_refusal_test.go drives every row.

rows.name: entry-versioning-1
rows.construct: a push creating a file whose entry version has versioning 1 (versionless), its sealed fields carrying content_sha256

twin.construct: the same push under a signature that is not its signer's

rows.name: entry-versioning-2
rows.construct: a push creating a file whose entry version has versioning 2 (a search index's file)

twin.construct: the same push under a signature that is not its signer's

rows.name: locator-kind-5
rows.construct: a push whose entry version's chain is a kind-5 locator, a versionless segment's one record after its 48 B header

twin.construct: the same entry with locator kind 6, which no format holds

rows.name: locator-staged
rows.construct: a push whose entry version cites a staged kind-5 segment: the staged mark on its locator, a staged-segment item in new-objects and the segment's bytes in the request's staged field

twin.construct: the same push under a signature that is not its signer's

rows.name: receipt-versionless
rows.construct: a format-1 shaped push adopting a kind-5 segment by a versionless receipt a format-2 instance issued under the shared receipt keys

twin.construct: the same push with a versionless receipt no receipt key made

rows.name: push-flag-256-field-33
rows.construct: a DROP: an EvsPush with flag 256 and drop_sha256 (field 33) over its EvsDropHistory, with the body and lists in payload sections 9 and 10

twin.construct: a push with flag 256 and no drop_sha256, which format 2 does not parse either

rows.name: push-flag-512
rows.construct: an erasure's CUT: an EvsPush with flag 512

twin.construct: the same push with flag 1024, which no format holds

rows.name: push-field-34
rows.construct: an index push: an EvsPush with index_epoch (field 34)

twin.construct: the same push under a signature that is not its signer's

rows.name: part-staged
rows.construct: a part of a push in parts carrying staged kind-5 segments in the request's staged field

twin.construct: a part of the same push with no staged bytes and no format-2 entry, under a signature that is not its signer's

rows.name: segment-header-kind-5
rows.construct: a segment upload whose bytes open with a 48 B kind-5 header (segment header format 2)

twin.construct: the same bytes with header format 3, which no format holds

rows.name: read-entry-versioning-1
rows.construct: a committed file whose newest entry version has versioning 1

twin.construct: the same reply with an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-entry-versioning-2
rows.construct: a committed file whose newest entry version has versioning 2

twin.construct: the same reply with an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-locator-kind-5
rows.construct: a committed versionless file whose chain is a kind-5 locator into a stored kind-5 segment

twin.construct: the same reply with an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-statement-flag-512
rows.construct: a ref whose log holds a committed CUT, an EvsPush with flag 512

twin.construct: the same statement under a signature its signer's key did not make

rows.name: read-statement-field-34
rows.construct: a ref whose log holds a committed EvsPush with index_epoch (field 34)

twin.construct: the same statement under a signature its signer's key did not make

rows.name: read-statement-flag-256
rows.construct: a ref whose log holds a committed DROP, an EvsPush with flag 256 and drop_sha256 (field 33)

twin.construct: the same statement under a signature its signer's key did not make

rows.name: read-state-collected
rows.construct: a read reply whose path state is collected

twin.construct: the reply with no state and an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-state-drop-pending
rows.construct: a read reply whose path state is drop_pending, with its drop_id and not_before_ms

twin.construct: the reply with no state and an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-state-dropped
rows.construct: a read reply whose path state is dropped, with its drop_id, drop_version, drop_statement and drop_body

twin.construct: the reply with no state and an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-segment-header-kind-5
rows.construct: a committed kept version whose segment locator names a segment that opens with a kind-5 header, an upload adopted when versioning was turned on (D-EVS-38)

twin.construct: the same version with its segment gone from the cluster

rows.name: read-removal-marker-ids
rows.construct: a removed path whose removal marker carries a versionless file's segment_ids and slot_ids

twin.construct: the removal with no ids and a path version off the versions rule

rows.name: read-provenance-tainted
rows.construct: a format-1 file whose push's sealed provenance has the tainted bit, committed by a format-1 evs

twin.construct: the same reply with an entry version that does not hash to its statement's

rows.name: read-window-bits-4-5
rows.construct: a head whose window entries carry bits 4 (a versionless version replaced) and 5 (a DROP): a format-1 evs commits on it, carrying them, and serves it

twin.construct: the same head with window bit 6, which no format holds

rows.name: read-batch-record-format-2
rows.construct: a ref whose newest push a format-2 evs stored as a format-2 batch record, its purge list after its body, in a format-2 batch: evs answers the read 409 FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED {needs_format: 2}

twin.construct: the same record with record format 3, which no format holds

rows.name: repo-format-2
rows.construct: a repo whose repo/ a format-2 push raised to format 2: a format-1 evs answers every push 503 with Retry-After, recording nothing, writes nothing and serves the stored bytes

twin.construct: a repo/ of format 3, which no format holds

rows.name: batch-format-2
rows.construct: a batch of format 2 holding a staged push's record with its staged bytes, past evacuation's age: a format-1 evacuator leaves it for a format-2 one under its evacuate_batch_format alarm, deleting nothing

twin.construct: a format-1 batch of the same record with a byte flipped

rows.name: write-ur-index-directory
rows.construct: a write under .ur-index/ on a file-mode ref

twin.construct: a write under .ur-indexes/

rows.name: write-ref-ur-index
rows.construct: a write on the ur/index ref

twin.construct: a write on a ref named ur/indexes

rows.name: write-ref-ur-lfs
rows.construct: a write on the ur/lfs ref

twin.construct: a write on a ref named ur/lfs-notes

rows.name: write-versioning-off
rows.construct: a write with versioning off

twin.construct: the same write with versioning on

rows.name: config-versioning-rules
rows.construct: a config head holding a signed VersioningRules record: the head compiles and applies as the one without it, taking nothing from the record

rows.name: acl-repo-versioning
rows.construct: a signed RepoVersioning statement in the access log: its signer verified, its lock folded into the repo's row, its sealed rules unread and no right changed

elsewhere.why: kept: a format-1 fold carries an entry's drop mark and a marker's carried ids unchanged, which is the fold's own state and not a push or a read

slot_rule.name: slot-unknown
slot_rule.construct: a push whose new version names a slot that neither the push introduces nor a version step 4 read names (11.8's 5h)
slot_rule.twin: the same version in a push that introduces the slot commits

slot_rule.name: slot-stale
slot_rule.construct: a push introducing a slot whose If-None-Match PUT meets an equal object over 23 h old (11.8 step 6)
slot_rule.twin: the push that first introduced the slot, sent again, meets its own committed record and answers 200

unswept.why: a head carries index_epoch only once a CUT committed, which raises the repo to format 2, where a format-1 evs takes no push; no format-1 code reads either field, and whether a format-1 reader should refuse a ref whose head summary carries one is not stated (11.6 lists it among what is refused in use, FS-72's constructs do not)
